links.outcome: Association of formal AI training with practitioners' perceived accuracy, patient satisfaction, and clinical outcomes
links.effect: Formal AI training was significantly associated with higher perceived decision-making accuracy (p = 0.019), patient satisfaction (p = 0.017), and clinical outcomes (p = 0.012). These are self-reported perceptions, not measured safe-use outcomes.
links.quote: Formal AI training was associated with higher perceived scores among dental practitioners highlighting the potential value of educational initiatives in fostering AI adoption.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey evaluating patient and dental practitioner awareness, acceptance, and perceptions of AI in dental care without evaluating an active deployment or testing a specific safeguard.
